title: AKI Prevention and Early Intervention in Patients Undergoing VAD Placement
brief_summary: The investigators are doing this research to find out if more careful assessment and elimination of potential risk factors of acute kidney injury (AKI) during the subject's perioperative period will reduce their chance of kidney damage and kidney damage related problems.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion criteria:

* Adult patients that will undergo VAD placement.
* Patients able to give consent

Exclusion criteria:

* Patients on dialysis (hemodialysis or peritoneal dialysis)
* Non-elective VAD placement (VAD implantation decision made within 24 hours)
